from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert_multiple([{'tag': 'a'}, {'tag': 'b'}, {'tag': 'a'}, {'tag': 'c'}])

# Issue scenario
res = db.search(Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a', 'b']))
print("issue scenario:", res)
print("issue scenario OK:", res == [{'tag': 'a'}, {'tag': 'b'}, {'tag': 'a'}])

# Edge: same query evaluated twice
q = Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a', 'b'])
print("first call 'a':", q({'tag': 'a'}))
print("second call 'a':", q({'tag': 'a'}))

# Edge: hash/equality of two equal generator queries
q1 = Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a'])
q2 = Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a'])
print("equal generator queries compare equal:", q1 == q2)

# List still works
ql = Query().tag.one_of(['a', 'b'])
print("list:", db.search(ql))
